tools.name: sosinventory_list_items
tools.description: List or search inventory items (products, assemblies, services...) with SKU, type, quantities (onhand, available, on sales/purchase orders) and prices. Filter by free text, SKU, category, type, tags, ids or update time; pass location to see quantities at one location. GET /api/v2/item.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_item
tools.description: One item by id with all fields: quantities, prices, accounts, vendor, category, units of measure, price tiers, custom fields. GET /api/v2/item/{id}.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_item_bom
tools.description: The bill of materials of an assembly item: component items, quantities and costs. GET /api/v2/item/{id}/bom.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_customers
tools.description: List or search customers with contact details, billing/shipping addresses, terms, sales rep and credit-hold flag. Filter by name/notes text, name, email or update time. GET /api/v2/customer.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id with all fields (addresses, contact, terms, price tier, custom fields). GET /api/v2/customer/{id}.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_vendors
tools.description: List or search vendors (suppliers) by name or notes, with contact details, address, terms and account number. GET /api/v2/vendor.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_vendor
tools.description: One vendor by id with all fields. GET /api/v2/vendor/{id}.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List or search sales orders with customer, dates, totals, order stage, channel and (with summary=false) line items with shipped/invoiced quantities. GET /api/v2/salesorder.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_sales_order
tools.description: One sales order by id with all fields and line items. GET /api/v2/salesorder/{id}.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List or search purchase orders with vendor, dates, expected receipt date, totals and (with summary=false) line items with received quantities. GET /api/v2/purchaseorder.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_purchase_order
tools.description: One purchase order by id with all fields and line items. GET /api/v2/purchaseorder/{id}.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_transactions
tools.description: List any SOS transaction type: invoices, estimates, sales receipts, item receipts, shipments, pick tickets, work orders, builds, adjustments, transfers, RMAs, returns, returns to vendor, rentals, rental returns and processes. tools.name: sosinventory_get_transaction
tools.description: One transaction of any type by id, with all fields and line items. GET /api/v2/{type}/{id}.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_reference_data
tools.description: List a configuration or reference table: locations, channels, classes, departments, payment terms, tax codes, sales reps, ship methods, payment methods, priorities, order stages, price tiers, units of measure, users (id, name, email), accounts, custom fields, warranties, bins, workers, work centers,

tools.name: sosinventory_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new customer record in SOS Inventory. Only name is required. Check sosinventory_list_customers first so you do not create a duplicate. POST /api/v2/customer.

tools.name: sosinventory_create_vendor
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new vendor (supplier) record in SOS Inventory. Only name is required. Check sosinventory_list_vendors first to avoid a duplicate. POST /api/v2/vendor.

tools.name: sosinventory_create_item
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new inventory item. Optionally books initial stock: SOS then creates an inventory adjustment for the quantity at the given location. Item names must be unique within their category: check sosinventory_list_items first. POST /api/v2/item.

tools.name: sosinventory_create_sales_order
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new sales order for an EXISTING customer with line items for existing items (a customer or item cannot be created inside an order: use the create tools first). The order number is assigned automatically (SOS auto-numbering) unless you pass one. Confirm the customer, items, quantitie

tools.name: sosinventory_create_purchase_order
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new purchase order to an EXISTING vendor with line items for existing items. The PO number is assigned automatically unless you pass one. Confirm the vendor, items, quantities and costs with the user before calling. POST /api/v2/purchaseorder.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "sosinventory_create_sales_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sosinventory_list_customers, sosinventory_list_transactions, sosinventory_list_reference_data, sosinventory_create_customer, sosinventory_create_vendor, sosinventory_create_item · Private data: sosinventory_list_customers, sosinventory_get_customer, sosinventory_list_vendors, sosinventory_create_customer, sosinventory_create_vendor · Public sink: sosinventory_list_customers, sosinventory_list_reference_data, sosinventory_create_customer, sosinventory_create_vendor, sosinventory_create_item, sosinventory_create_sales_order, sosinventory_create_purchase_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sosinventory_list_customers, sosinventory_list_transactions, sosinventory_list_reference_data, sosinventory_create_customer, sosinventory_create_vendor, sosinventory_create_item · Private data: sosinventory_list_customers, sosinventory_get_customer, sosinventory_list_vendors, sosinventory_create_customer, sosinventory_create_vendor · Public sink: sosinventory_list_customers, sosinventory_list_reference_data, sosinventory_create_customer, sosinventory_create_vendor, sosinventory_create_item, sosinventory_create_sales_order, sosinventory_create_purchase_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
